asset.name: MarkdownMessage
asset.description: The safe rich-message renderer with lazily loaded code highlighting, tables, links, citations, task lists, copy affordances, and resilient handling of partial markup during streaming.

requires.reason: Incremental rendering, batching, and announcement policy are shared.
Code fences render through the shared block with lazy highlighting.

suggests.reason: Only transcripts with sourced answers need inline references.

rationale: Partial markup is the streaming hazard: a half-arrived code fence or table must render as readable text rather than collapsing the layout, then upgrade cleanly once the delimiter arrives.
